throughput_targets: Target: support sustained 5k qps of embedding lookups (batched) and 300 concurrent chat sessions during peak; expected tokens/sec target per GPU ~200-350 depending on model/seq length
latency_SLOs: Desired SLOs: chat p50 < 60ms, p95 < 150ms for 32-token turn; embeddings p95 < 50ms for batched requests (batch size 64); fallbacks to smaller model if SLOs violated
reserved_capacity_plan: Exploring 3 commit levels: 4 GPUs (baseline), 8 GPUs (recommended for steady load), 16 GPUs (peak/burst with burst capacity). Ask: autoscaling burst + guaranteed pool. Preference for A100-class or equivalent; open to mixed-instance (quantized) profiles for cost savings.
cost_model_assumptions: Base assumptions used in workshop: price reference tiers for reserved GPUs (monthly commit): 4 -> $24k/mo, 8 -> $44k/mo, 16 -> $80k/mo. Utilization cases: conservative 40% avg, expected 60% avg, optimistic 80% avg. Effective unit economics calculated as (monthly_commit_cost / (utilization * provisioned_capacity_hours * tokens_per_hour)). Example: 8-GPU, expected 60% util, modeled 8 GPUs * 24h * 30d * 0.6 util * 1.2M tokens/hour per GPU => unit cost ~ $0.00028/token generation. Sensitivity: at 40% util unit cost increases ~1.5x; at 80% util decreases ~0.75x. Additional line items: burst overage pricing, network egress, storage for KV cache. Need formalized per-model unit rates and a blended rate across model families for contract. Finance asked for break-even utilization and payback period for commit delta vs on-demand.
poC_findings: POC: 4-GPU pool -> solid throughput for embeddings, chat p95 ~230ms on baseline model. Identified optimization levers: batching, prefix caching, quantized model variants and kernel tuning. SE recommends moving to 8 GPUs for target SLO headroom; consider 16 GPUs for holiday peak. Also recommended dedicated KV cache nodes for low-latency chat state.
sla_negotiation_points: Customer requests: explicit latency SLOs per route with credits for breaches; guaranteed throughput per GPU; defined maintenance windows and advance notice; data residency clause for us-east-1; stronger indemnity for regulated customers. Redwood to propose SLA addendum with measurable metrics and escalations.
